name: sparx — Brand Newsroom
tagline: A dark, cover-art brand-newsroom template for a studio that ships and sells.
description: A first-party brand newsroom for a product studio — a big latest-release feature over a live launch feed, a release-notes changelog, a spotlight drop, and a bound store carousel, on a true-dark ground with one electric-violet accent. Modelled on the brand-community-newsroom archetype; shipped as Launch Notes. Ships a light studio store (merch) to demonstrate content + commerce together.
